Ihr wählt ein Abo aus: Netflix, ChatGPT oder Claude. Darauf gibt es 50% zurück, gedeckelt bei 10€ im Monat. Bei Netflix deckt das die Hälfte vollständig ab, bei ChatGPT und Claude liegt ihr wegen des höheren Abopreises knapp darunter.

Thinking about the future of Bitcoin as money after BIP-110. 

Bitcoin is increasingly settling into its role as high power money, reserve asset, gold 2.0. 

Bitcoin is the heavy final settlement tier. 10 minute blocks, power intensive, *relatively* cumbersome at times- on purpose. That's what secure + reliable final settlement costs.

Okay, so what’s the transaction tier? I find Kaspa interesting as a possible fit for this role. 

kaspa:native is the lightweight currency tier. Cheap blocks, fast confirmation. Low friction. 

Not layers. Two separate LIs doing two separate jobs.

The echo of the bimetallic standard, only with a free floating exchange ratio.

A larger, new crop of investors will enter while BTC is hot and pay a hefty premium for it, believing the momentum will continue indefinitely.

Until it doesn't.

Bitcoin will fall. MSTR will fall harder. The premium will collapse back to ~1.0.

The new investors will get angry. They will blame management.

And the world will once again deem the business model broken.

Until bitcoin rips all over again.

MSTR will win.
